profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at Etsy
profile.summary: Full stack developer leveraging AWS, PHP, Python, and more in a marketing agency environment.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Backfilling · PHP · React.js · API Development · A/B Testing · LangChain · Database Design · Front-End Development

positions.title: Senior PHP Developer
positions.description:
• Core development of in-house MVC
• AWS security and infrastructure auditing
• Developed Raspberry Pi kiosks to replace traditional desktop computers
• NMS/IDS implementation on AWS
• Training and code review with junior developers
• Single sign-on integration with WordPress
• Increased warehouse productivity through a variety of custom applications
• Reduced hardware costs by assisting in migration to AWS

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
• Custom WordPress and Magento development
• Payment processor integration
• Responsive sites using Bootstrap
• Created client-friendly management consoles
• ColdFusion development on MedSeek platform

positions.title: Chief Business Development Officer
positions.description:
• Reduced lost sales by implementing order fulfillment procedures
• Highest ratings received in customer service and support
• Moved +60% of sales from traditional channels to online
• Prototyped, documented, and assembled new products
• Developed M2M global data acquisition system through SMS, GPRS, and more

positions.title: Executive Director of Progress
positions.description:
• Developed, launched and maintained highly customized websites for clients
• Experience with sales acquisition and customer relationship management with local business owners
• Created and executed social media strategies for small business owners
• Managed all company finances and bookkeeping
